datasets.title: Floods and landslides in KwaZulu-Natal (Republic of South Africa)
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20220418ZAF Webmap of satellite based analysis related to the Floods and landslides of 13 Apr. 2022 in KwaZulu-Natal (Republic of South Africa).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/floods-and-landslides-in-kwazulu-natal-republic-of-south-africa]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed and compared satellite imagery from before and after the 13 April 2022 event to identify flood inundation extents and landslide occurrence areas. The analysis produced vector geodatabase and shapefile outputs representing observed hazard impacts across KwaZulu-Natal.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis comparing pre- and post-event images to identify flood and landslide extents and damage patterns in KwaZulu-Natal province.
